title: Compare 3 PDF Quotes with AI: Is the Lowest Unit Price Really Cheapest?
description:
You cannot simply sort the unit prices in three PDF quotes. Follow one original set of postcard quotes: have AI organize specifications, quantities, tax status, shipping and source page numbers, then use the stated terms to calculate comparable delivered totals. Check the results again after receiving a revision and changing the quantity from 10 cards to 20.

This demo uses Codex AI document analysis, pypdf text extraction and exact decimal calculations to produce an editable spreadsheet. It does not claim to have tested the upload interface of any particular commercial AI product. The suppliers, prices and 5% tax rate are original practice settings, not tax advice for real transactions.

Data and implementation date: 2026-10-26. These PDFs have selectable text; this text extraction workflow does not perform OCR on scanned images. The spreadsheet values were actually calculated by a calculation tool. openpyxl only writes the file; no claim is made that it calculates formulas.

The materials include requirements, prompts, a source PDF generator, page-by-page extracted text, an editable quote comparison sheet and version records.

The seven-line prompt on screen gives the viewer's task requirements. The machine-readable field format is specified separately in the JSON contract in analysis-prompt.txt; this AI analysis also read that contract.

Original materials, requirements and full prompts:
https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/e2631cfb53c2b275345001ae9df7b60135e5035a/docs/videos/ai-pdf-quotes-to-comparison/materials
